findings.text: 06_2 live ratio readout (25.4-31.5 s): '2.43 + 2.00 i', '2.00 + 2.45 i', '1.64 + 2.18 i' are set as separately placed pieces with gaps about a digit wide around the plus and before the i (3x crop s0229-ratio-readouts3x-b.png). The settled readout at 34.1 s, '-> 2.000 + 2.000 i', has normal spacing (s0230-slot6-limit3x.png), so the live and settled forms look different. Same family as L5 (counters built from separate parts). Suggest typesetting the live readout as one expression, or tightening the gaps.
Recurs in the 06_2 ratio readouts: the i in '2.43 + 2.00 i' and '-> 2.000 + 2.000 i' is upright, while 'z_0 = 1 + i' in the input panel and 'z_0^2 = 2i' set it italic.
